divisions.title: To the Worshipful John Upton of Lupton, Esq, and the most accomplished and vertuous Lady his dear Consort; the Author wishes Grace, Mercy and Peace.
A Table of Scriptures occasionally opened in this TREATISE.
For ever blessed be God for Jesus Christ.
